In some communities, it is an eminent title conferred upon the head of a religious order, a leader or a teacher, symbolizing their position of esteem and influence within their community.

It implies that the person bearing this name has attained a level of spiritual growth and understanding, often associated with a life dedicated to serving and bettering the community and those around them. The name carries a deep spiritual resonance, reminding us of the importance of living a virtuous life and striving towards spiritual enlightenment.
